verdict.rationale: GitLab documents headless automation through its REST API, which it describes as built to automate workflows and manage CI/CD across projects. The API supports token-based auth (personal access tokens, Bearer, OAuth 2.0) and a full OpenAPI spec, and GitLab ships its own CI/CD, an official CLI, a Duo CLI, and agent flows with configurable triggers. Missing for 10: explicit docs on running the CLI or Duo agents non-interactively inside CI pipelines, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless agentic runs.
